newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Savage yr profit halves to A$11.9 mln.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Savage yr profit halves to A$11.9 mln.

text.p: Savage Resources Ltd said on Wednesday its 1996/97 (June/July) net profit was A$11.9 million.
The company said this result was slightly above the result forecast in the March quarterly report. It compared with a 1995/96 net profit of a record A$23.1 million.
Savage said it would pay an unfranked final dividend of one cent per share, making a total annual payment of two cents.
It said the record date for the final dividend was August 29 with a payment date of October 30.

"Given that there has recently been a substantial rise in LME zinc prices, the company is confident that the outlook for the year ahead is most favourable and the focus of the company will be to concentrate on the profitable further development and improvement of its substantial existing businesses and to pursue profitable opportunities as they arise," Savage said.
The company, which has key mining and smelting operations in the United States along with coal operations in Australia, said it was continuing to perform satisfactorily.
Savage is a 49 percent shareholder in the giant Ernest Henry copper/gold project in the Australian state of Queensland, with the remainder held by MIM Holdings Ltd.
